class VeraGrid.plugins.PluginFunction[source]

Bases: object

Class to handle external function pointers

get_pointer_lambda(gui_instance: ConfigurationMain) → Callable[source]

Really hard core magic to avoid lambdas shadow each other due to late binding

lambda e=True, func=self.function_ptr: func(self)

explanation: - e is a bool parameter that the QAction sends when triggered,

set it by default True, otherwise fails on windows

  • func=self.function_ptr is there for the lambda to force the usage of the value of self.function_ptr

    during the iteration and not after the loop since lambdas in a loop are lazy evaluated

  • func(self) is then what I wanted to lambda in the first place

VeraGrid.plugins.load_function_from_file_path(file_path: str, function_name: str)[source]

Dynamically load a function from a Python file at a given file path.

Parameters:

  • file_path – The path to the Python (.py) file.

  • function_name – The name of the function to load from the file.

Returns:

The loaded function object.

Raises:

  • FileNotFoundError – If the specified file does not exist.

  • ImportError – If the module cannot be imported.

  • AttributeError – If the function does not exist in the module.

  • TypeError – If the retrieved attribute is not callable.
